usageNotes: Use this to update the comment, nomatch flag, or digest guard on an existing CIDR entry within a VM-level firewall IP set; the CIDR itself is a path parameter and cannot be changed in-place — to change the address, delete and re-add the entry. Requires VM.Config.Network on /vms/{vmid}. Returns null synchronously (no UPID); the change is applied immediately to the in-memory firewall ruleset.

examples.summary: Add a comment and set nomatch on an existing IP set entry for VM 101

tips: Pass 'digest' to guard against concurrent edits — retrieve it from the GET endpoint for the same IP set entry before writing.
Setting 'nomatch' to true inverts the match for this CIDR, useful for punching exceptions into a broader allow/deny range.
The IP set 'name' must already exist; use post_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_firewall_ipset to create the set and post_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_firewall_ipset_name to add entries.
The cidr path parameter accepts plain IPs, CIDR notation, or Proxmox aliases — ensure the value matches exactly what was used when the entry was created.
